# The repository is as declared, protected without the check ci, with its declaration, but this
# folder has no component code and no ci.yml (the declaration was born with components). With
# confirm=yes the starting points and ci.yml are written here and proposed in one pull request
# (#7): the run ends "updated", nothing is applied on GitHub, and the protection keeps no check.
# git status lists the generated files once ci.yml's reusable workflow commit was read.
FILE web/go.mod ^module github\.com/example-org/demo/web$
FILE services/api/main.go api: ok
FILE .github/workflows/ci.yml ^# aleogr-ci 1 api:services/api:go:1\.27,web:web:go:1\.27$
CALLED ^git add -- .*web/go\.mod
CALLED ^git commit -m "?Add the components api, web and CI"? -- 
CALLED ^gh pr create --repo example-org/demo
NOT_CALLED --method|^git .*push .*origin main
OUTPUT "status": "updated"
OUTPUT merge https://github\.com/example-org/demo/pull/7
OUTPUT_NOT paths=
NOT_CALLED ruleset-main-ci
